The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.

To call this service, we recommend that you use the Google-provided client libraries. If your application needs to use your own libraries to call this service, use the following information when you make the API requests.

Discovery document

A Discovery Document is a machine-readable specification for describing and consuming REST APIs. It is used to build client libraries, IDE plugins, and other tools that interact with Google APIs. One service may provide multiple discovery documents. This service provides the following discovery document:

  • https://gmail.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1

Service endpoint

A service endpoint is a base URL that specifies the network address of an API service. One service might have multiple service endpoints. This service has the following service endpoint and all URIs below are relative to this service endpoint:

📰 Global Technology Expansion Accelerates in 2026

The global technology sector continues to experience rapid expansion in 2026, driven by major investments in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and automation systems. Industry analysts report that businesses across multiple sectors are adopting advanced digital solutions to improve efficiency and remain competitive in the evolving global market.

According to recent reports, companies are focusing heavily on AI-powered tools that can analyze large volumes of data, automate repetitive tasks, and support decision-making processes. Experts believe that this technological transformation will reshape traditional industries such as manufacturing, healthcare, and education.

Government agencies and international organizations, including the United Nations, have also emphasized the need for responsible technology development. They stress that ethical regulations, cybersecurity measures, and workforce training programs will play a critical role in ensuring sustainable digital growth worldwide.

🌍 Global Climate Efforts Show Positive Progress

International climate initiatives have recently shown promising results as many countries report significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions. Environmental experts highlight the rapid growth of renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power, which have become more affordable and widely accessible.

Countries including India, Germany, and Japan have increased investments in clean energy infrastructure, aiming to reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Scientists state that improved energy efficiency, stricter environmental policies, and global cooperation have contributed to measurable progress.

However, climate researchers warn that long-term success will require continuous commitment from governments, industries, and individuals. They emphasize that immediate action remains essential to prevent severe environmental impacts in the future.

🎓 Education Systems Embrace Digital Learning Transformation

Educational institutions worldwide are undergoing a major shift toward digital learning technologies. Schools and universities are increasingly adopting online platforms, virtual classrooms, and AI-based tutoring systems to enhance student learning experiences.

Education experts report that hybrid learning models, which combine traditional classroom teaching with digital tools, have significantly improved accessibility and engagement. Students in remote and rural areas now have better opportunities to access high-quality educational resources through online programs.

Organizations such as UNESCO are actively supporting digital education initiatives by promoting technological infrastructure and training programs for teachers. Experts predict that digital learning will continue to play a central role in shaping future education systems globally.

💼 Global Economy Shows Steady Recovery Trends

Recent economic data suggests that the global economy is showing steady recovery following years of financial uncertainty. Strong consumer spending, increased trade activities, and growth in digital industries have contributed to improved economic stability.

Financial analysts report that emerging markets are experiencing rapid growth due to investments in infrastructure, technology, and renewable energy sectors. However, economists caution that challenges such as inflation, supply chain disruptions, and geopolitical tensions still require careful management.

International financial institutions, including the International Monetary Fund, recommend continued policy cooperation among nations to maintain economic stability and support sustainable development.
